Our client is a well-established Australian food manufacturer operating across multiple sites in Melbourne's north and west, supplying high-care food products to one of the country's leading national retailers. With a workforce of several hundred people across the group and a strong reputation for quality and consistency, the business continues to grow its volumes and capability.

You will lead a team made up of a Maintenance Supervisor, fitters, electricians, apprentices and a parts coordinator. You will also help shape the team's future structure, including bringing on a Maintenance Planner.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Leading, coaching and developing the maintenance team, lifting performance and building a positive, accountable team culture
  • Moving the site from a reactive to a proactive maintenance model through preventative maintenance programs within the CMMS (MEX)
  • Overseeing the servicing, repair and modification of automated processing, packaging and conveyor equipment
  • Ensuring all maintenance activities meet food safety, hygiene and high-care standards
  • Managing the maintenance budget, including spend and overtime, and working closely with Finance on cost control
  • Contributing to weekly department head meetings and collaborating with Operations, Quality and Safety
  • Supporting the rollout of new equipment and automation projects as the site expands
  • Coordinating weekend preventative maintenance and shutdown activities

About You
As the successful candidate, you will have:
  • A trade qualification, ideally electrical (dual trade highly regarded), or a relevant engineering degree
  • Proven experience leading a maintenance team in food manufacturing or FMCG. Meat or protein processing experience is highly regarded.
  • Strong technical knowledge of automation, PLCs and process equipment
  • Hands-on experience with a CMMS (MEX highly regarded) and implementing preventative maintenance strategies
  • Strong people leadership skills, with a coaching mindset and the ability to manage performance and attitude challenges constructively
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to engage with a diverse, multicultural workforce
  • Experience managing budgets and controlling maintenance spend
  • A good understanding of enterprise agreements and a strong safety-first mindset
  • The ability to be on call as required and availability during key peak trading periods (e.g. Christmas and major long weekends)
A competitive salary is on offer, along with the opportunity to join a stable, growing business that genuinely invests in the development of its people.
